newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Bruton says EMU will happen on time.
newsitem.headline: Bruton says EMU will happen on time.

text.p: Irish Prime Minister John Bruton said on Tuesday after meeting with fellow centrist political leaders of the EU that he believed the planned European single currency would go ahead on time.
"I don't believe postponement will occur. (EMU) will happen on time with Ireland taking part," Bruton told the Irish Times newspaper for a story to appear on Wednesday.
"I haven't the slightest doubt that the political will exists and will be delivered on time to go ahead with the single currency in 1999," he told the newspaper.

Bruton was attending a Brussels summit of the mainly Christian Democratic European Peoples Party. Other leaders at the meeting included German Chancellor Helmut Kohl, Italian Premier Romano Prodi and Spanish Prime Minister Jose-Marie Aznar.
